research_question: Does instructor beauty affect teaching productivity as reflected in student instructional ratings?

ivs.description: Rating of the instructor's physical appearance by a panel of six students, averaged and shifted to have a mean of zero (beauty).

dv.description: Course overall teaching evaluation score (student instructional rating) on a scale from 1 (very unsatisfactory) to 5 (excellent).

controls.description: Number of students that participated in the evaluation.
Number of students enrolled in the course.
Factor: does the instructor belong to a minority (non-Caucasian)? (categorical control).
Factor: is the course a single-credit elective (e.g., yoga, aerobics, dance)? (categorical control).
Factor: is the course an upper- or lower-division course? (categorical control).
Factor: is the instructor a native English speaker? (categorical control).
Factor: is the instructor on the tenure track? (categorical control).

extracted_analysis.analysis_code:
import pandas as pd
import statsmodels.formula.api as smf


def main():
    df = pd.read_csv('teachingratings.csv')

    # Simple model: ratings vs beauty
    m1 = smf.ols('allstudents ~ beauty', data=df).fit()

    # Controls: treat string columns as categorical
    # Exclude likely identifiers (division, students)
    formula = (
        'allstudents ~ beauty + age + rownames + minority '
        '+ C(eval) + C(tenure) + C(prof) + C(native) + C(gender) + C(credits)'
    )
    m2 = smf.ols(formula, data=df).fit()

    print('N:', len(df))
    print('\nSimple model: allstudents ~ beauty')
    print(m1.summary().tables[1])
    print('\nControlled model: allstudents ~ beauty + controls')
    print(m2.summary().tables[1])

    # Extra: effect size for 1 SD increase in beauty
    beauty_sd = df['beauty'].std()
    coef_simple = m1.params['beauty']
    coef_ctrl = m2.params['beauty']
    print('\nBeauty SD:', beauty_sd)
    print('Simple model: 1 SD beauty effect on rating:', coef_simple * beauty_sd)
    print('Controlled model: 1 SD beauty effect on rating:', coef_ctrl * beauty_sd)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
